d:
Rajasthani gatta kari ko ekdam mulayam gatton aur svadisht grevi ke sath banana chahte hain ? gatton ko sopht banane ki sabhi jaruri tips aur speshal grevi banane ka sahi aur aasan tarika ke sath Authentic Rajasthani Gatte Ki Sabzi dekhiye, jismen gatte rahenge ekdam Soft aur grevi banegi garhi, svadisht aur sahi masalon ka santulan ke sath. yah resipi roti, paratha, puri aur jira rais ke sath bahut svadisht lagti hai.
